gamma_deformation.gamma_BF: - gb(sigma, k, s1) b_l^{s2} b_m^{s3} - gb(sigma, l, s2) b_k^{s1} b_m^{s3}
gamma_deformation.gamma_FF: - gb(sigma2, k, s1) a_1^{sigma1} b_l^{s2} - gb(sigma1, l, s2) a_1^{sigma2} b_k^{s1}

triviality_proof.step1: Assume f(B) = 0 by Whitehead's lemma for sp(2n) and non-zero action of so(2).
triviality_proof.step2: gamma(B, F) = delta_f(B, F) uniquely determines an even mapping f(F).
triviality_proof.step3: gamma(F1, F2) evaluates to -delta_f(F1, F2) for this unique mapping.
triviality_proof.conclusion: The signs strictly require gamma(F1, F2) = 0, which implies all gb parameters must be zero.
